{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace Contract

inductive Edit where
  | mk (start : Nat) (end : Nat) (text : String)

inductive Result where
  | ok (text : String)
  | boundary (edit : Nat)
  | overlap (edit : Nat)

def utf16Len (s : String) : Nat :=
  s.length

def validBoundary (s : String) (pos : Nat) : Bool :=
  pos ≤ s.length

def isAdjacent (e1 : Edit) (e2 : Edit) : Bool :=
  e1.end == e2.start

def isZeroLength (e : Edit) : Bool :=
  e.start == e.end

def solve (text : String) (edits : List Edit) : Result :=
  let n := text.length
  let mut i := 0
  let mut prevEnd := 0
  while i < edits.length do
    let e := edits.get! i
    if !validBoundary text e.start || !validBoundary text e.end then
      return Result.boundary i
    if e.start < prevEnd then
      return Result.overlap i
    prevEnd := e.end
    i := i + 1
  let mut result := text
  let mut j := edits.length - 1
  while j ≥ 0 do
    let e := edits.get! j
    let before := result.take e.start
    let after := result.drop e.end
    result := before ++ e.text ++ after
    j := j - 1
  Result.ok result

theorem thm_boundary (text : String) (edits : List Edit) (i : Nat) :
  i < edits.length →
  let e := edits.get! i
  (¬ validBoundary text e.start ∨ ¬ validBoundary text e.end) →
  solve text edits = Result.boundary i := by sorry

theorem thm_overlap (text : String) (edits : List Edit) (i : Nat) :
  i < edits.length →
  let e := edits.get! i
  validBoundary text e.start → validBoundary text e.end →
  (∀ j : Nat, j < i → let ej := edits.get! j; validBoundary text ej.start ∧ validBoundary text ej.end ∧ ej.end ≤ e.start) →
  e.start < edits.get! (i - 1).end →
  solve text edits = Result.overlap i := by sorry

theorem thm_success (text : String) (edits : List Edit) :
  (∀ i : Nat, i < edits.length → let e := edits.get! i; validBoundary text e.start ∧ validBoundary text e.end) →
  (∀ i : Nat, i < edits.length → i > 0 → let e := edits.get! i; let prev := edits.get! (i - 1); e.start ≥ prev.end) →
  ∃ result : String, solve text edits = Result.ok result := by sorry

theorem thm_error_format (text : String) (edits : List Edit) (i : Nat) :
  i < edits.length →
  (solve text edits = Result.boundary i ∨ solve text edits = Result.overlap i) →
  ∃ err : String, ∃ idx : Nat, (solve text edits = Result.boundary idx ∧ idx = i) ∨ (solve text edits = Result.overlap idx ∧ idx = i) := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (text : String) (edits : List Edit) (i : Nat),
    i < edits.length ∧
    let e := edits.get! i
    (¬ validBoundary text e.start ∨ ¬ validBoundary text e.end) ∧
    solve text edits = Result.boundary i ∧
    ∃ (text2 : String) (edits2 : List Edit) (i2 : Nat),
      i2 < edits2.length ∧
      let e2 := edits2.get! i2
      validBoundary text2 e2.start ∧ validBoundary text2 e2.end ∧
      (∀ j : Nat, j < i2 → let ej := edits2.get! j; validBoundary text2 ej.start ∧ validBoundary text2 ej.end ∧ ej.end ≤ e2.start) ∧
      e2.start < edits2.get! (i2 - 1).end ∧
      solve text2 edits2 = Result.overlap i2 := by sorry

end Contract",
